text: {"themes":[{"label":"Lead fracture or breakage during procedures","description":"Narratives describe leads that were severed, fractured, or broke during placement, removal, or extraction, with imaging or inspection noted in some reports.","report_keys":["50949318","50948697","50899604","50869095","50869092"]},{"label":"Incision site infection and wound concerns","description":"Reports describe suspected or confirmed infections, reopened or eroding incisions, and antibiotic treatment at or near the implant site.","report_keys":["50937584","50936648","50928010","50901693","50900578","50886588","50885184","50804957"]},{"label":"High impedance and connection readings","description":"Narratives describe impedance errors, red ohms, or bad contact readings during implant, trial, or programming, with some reports noting troubleshooting steps.","report_keys":["50947936","50867972","50867030","50858500","50842915","50842912","50840744","50839747"]},{"label":"Component damage and unexpected stimulation","description":"Reports describe damaged connectors, boots, introducers, or other components, and some describe shocks or changing amplitude settings reported by patients.","report_keys":["50885794","50840744","50867030","50899606","50839514"]},{"label":"Bleeding, procedure setup, and trial removal","description":"Narratives describe bleeding after an implant, a case aborted over positioning, patient-removed trial leads, and patient-reported pain or follow-up contact issues.","report_keys":["50808902","50812902","50872338","50871705","50869437","50792854"]}]}
